facts.fact: The Ministry of Digital Transition presented digital-training infrastructure investments in the PND 2026-2030, with an estimated budget of 95 billion FCFA, aiming to train tens of thousands of digital talents across the territory, under a strategy pillar on developing digital skills.

systems.system: PND 2026-2030 digital strategy (seven pillars, 40 structuring projects)
